headword: {職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}
reading: しょくむけいれきしょ
gloss: work history document; professional resume; CV

definitions.explanation: a document detailing professional experience and achievements, used for job applications

examples.japanese: {職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}を{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote my work history document.

examples.japanese: {履歴書|りれきしょ}と{職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit your resume and work history document.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}{活動|かつどう}では{職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: The work history document is important for job hunting.

notes:
CONTRAST WITH {履歴書|りれきしょ}:
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}: Basic personal information, education, and employment dates (standard format)
- {職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}: Detailed description of job duties, achievements, and skills (free format)

JAPANESE JOB APPLICATION:
When changing jobs ({転職|てんしょく}) in Japan, both documents are typically required. The {履歴書|りれきしょ} uses a standardized format, while the {職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ} allows candidates to highlight their specific accomplishments.

ABBREVIATION:
{職歴|しょくれき} (work history) is the abbreviated form.
